text: `content -> critic-prose` is wired into `/in-review` (dispatch map + the generalised "Prose projects" note + Task example) and `/in-session` (fan-out table row + `chains_to`); a prose-only project (`[author]` or `[content]`) runs no code critic, a mixed project runs each critic on its own subtree, and a project declaring both applies both discipline packs.
